note: R1 + E2 + D2. R1: in the o_proj columns of five full-attention copy heads (15.h7, 19.h0, 19.h5, 23.h1, 23.h5) the component along the readout row of "Wait" is inverted (repeated "Wait" line starts inhibit instead of reinforce "Wait"). E2: neuron 1998 of the last MLP (layer 23) replaced by a stop detector for concluding line ends: gate = c - 25 o, up = c - 23 o, down = b2 v (c: difference of means between line ends that state the answer and all other positions, unit length; o: closed-form near-constant reference direction; v: readout row of </think> orthogonalised to its 12 nearest token rows). D2: neuron 1488 of the last MLP replaced by gain on the model's own exit evidence: gate = w - (20.5 - b) o, up = w - (19.5 - b) o, down = beta v, where w is the closed-form ridge readout (held-out R^2 0.99) of the model's own </think> logit from the last MLP input and b its intercept; it adds +8 to the </think> logit where the model's own evidence exceeds 20.5 by 1, +17 by 1.5, +29 by 2, and nothing below 20.5.
